channel.desc: Meet \"Lara Benito\"?a model, singer, and an all-around entertainer with energy that lights up every room she walks into. Now, she?s taking that unstoppable spark on a journey across Korea to experience the country?s \"flavors\", \"style\", and \"retreats\". From hidden food spots to vibrant cultural scenes and peaceful escapes, Lara hops from place to place, guided by her curiosity and her unmistakable flair for fun. Everywhere she goes, she brings laughter, warmth, and a whole lot of excitement. With Lara?s playful spirit leading the way, Korea reveals itself in vivid color?delicious, stylish, and unexpectedly touching.
